title: When Grief and Anguish Press Me Down
description: When Grief and Anguish Press Me Down in Tonic Solfa to ST ANNE, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1848), as hymn 262, “Trust in the Lord”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST ANNE; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: When grief and an-guish press me down, And hope and com-fort flee, I cling, O Fa-ther, to Thy throne, And stay my heart on Thee.

lines: When grief and anguish press me down,
I cling, O Father, to Thy throne,
And stay my heart on Thee.
When death invades my peaceful home,
A closer bond, in time to come,
To bind my heart to Thee.
Lord, not my will, but Thine, be done!
My soul, from fear set free,
Her faith shall anchor at Thy throne,

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1848.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848); set to ST ANNE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
